messages:
matt-devex: Quick flag: found inconsistent error shapes between SDKs for streaming failures. Python returns a typed StreamingAbortError with retry_hint; JS surfaces a plain Error. Support tickets spiking.
anya: Oof. Which scenario?
sam: Repro: start stream, mid-stream connection drop, server emits a 499-stream-abort code. Python wraps as StreamingAbortError(retryable=true, hint='resume-token:xyz'), JS just gives NetworkError.
jess: Users following the sample-app see different retry behavior depending on SDK. Bad first impression.
leo: Suggest we standardize an error contract: keys type,status,retryable,retry_after,hint,docs. SDKs map to native exceptions but keep those fields.
matt-devex: Concrete: add StreamChunkError (resume possible) and StreamConnError (retryable=false). Map status codes -> retryable boolean: 408/502/503 => true, 401/403 => false, 429 => RateLimit + retry_after.
anya: I'll draft a terse spec and example payloads for Python/JS/Go. For resume, prefer explicit resume token when available, else offset hint.
sam: I'll implement a RedwoodStreamingError class in JS exposing .type,.retryable,.hint. For Python we'll add .error_info dict on exceptions for parity.
jess: I'll update sample-app retry logic and onboarding FAQ to show 401->UnauthorizedError (action: refresh token) and 429->RateLimitError (show retry_after).
leo: I'll add integration tests in sdk-integration-tests to simulate mid-stream aborts and assert error fields.
ci-bot: CI queued for branch stream-error-contract 1 tests queued.
matt-devex: Plan: 1) spec (anya) 2) tests (leo) 3) sample-app/docs (jess) 4) SDK patches (sam + others) 5) rollout telemetry check. Aim for beta next week.
anya: Pushing spec draft now.
sam: Starting JS patch once CI is green.
jess: Will add troubleshooting blurb to reduce support noise.
leo: Opening infra PR for tests in a bit.
matt-devex: Thanks all, nice cross-team sync :tada:
